Field guide · version 0.4 · free and open source

How an agent should build a WordPress page.

Read the site. Check the markup. Bind the data. Voyager Open Blocks teaches an agent that loop, one SKILL.md at a time, and ships five patterns to practise it on.

For
teams that let an agent edit WordPress
Needs
WordPress 6.9+, PHP 8.1+
License

Every task runs the same three steps, in the same order.

  1. 01Read the siteWesper
  2. 02Check the markupBlock Runner

01

Read the site

skills/voyager-open-blocks

The agent learns what this site accepts before it writes a line.

Wesper collects the registered blocks, the theme's tokens and every field that can be bound. A pattern that asks for a block the site lacks, or a colour the theme never defined, is caught here instead of on the live page.

02

Check the markup

block-runner 1.0.0

Nothing is saved until the editor's own parser accepts it.

Block Runner assembles the agent's intent into block markup, then validates it strictly against the site context. Exit 0 is a pass. Exit 1 means fix and validate again, and the skill says never to save markup that still fails.

03

Bind real data

voyager/site-data

The phone number comes from the site, not from the agent's memory.

The pack binds block attributes to Settings › Site Data and to allowlisted post meta. The bind ability only accepts arguments its catalog lists, and get-post-blocks reports each binding as resolved or fell back, with the reason.

04

Five patterns to practise on.

Each one is core blocks and the active theme's presets, nothing else, so it looks like whatever theme it lands on. Below, four plates on this page's theme and one on a dark theme. The fifth pattern closes the page.

05
Add the voyager-open/cta-band pattern to the end of the Services page. Rewrite the heading and the line of copy for that page, keep the click-to-call button bound to voyager/site-data phone_link, and validate the page with Block Runner before saving.One prompt the skills are written for. Start the agent at skills/voyager-open-blocks/SKILL.md.
Skillsnpx skills add voyager-marketing/voyager-open-blocks
Plugin zipwp plugin install voyager-open-blocks.zip --activate
Composercomposer require voyager-marketing/voyager-open-blocks

Five abilities (get-catalog, get-post-blocks, insert, configure, bind) reach the same pack over REST and MCP. Or skip installing and open it in Playground.
